name: Fringe-leaf ruellia
desc: Fringe-leaf ruellia (Ruellia humilis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Ruellia humilis (wild petunia, fringeleaf wild petunia, hairy petunia, low wild petunia) is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. It is native to the eastern United States.
